nodes.label: Engine DJ: what writing back to it involves
Engine DJ database schema 3.0.2: m.db SQLite with Playlists, PlaylistEntities, Tracks, PerformanceData
nodes.rationale: One database per place Engine DJ uses (Computer, each drive); playlist tree replicated across all with same ids; songs identified by (originDatabaseUuid, originTrackId); triggers maintain referential integrity

nodes.label: Engine DJ playlist tree: 763 playlists replicated across databases with entries naming their source database
nodes.rationale: Same playlist tree in every Engine DJ database; entries reference which database their song is in via databaseUuid; Engine DJ reconciles trees when drives disconnect and reconnect

nodes.label: PerformanceData: cues, loops, beat grid stored as compressed/uncompressed binary blobs per song
nodes.rationale: quickCues (compressed), loops (little-endian uncompressed), beatData (compressed with markers), trackData; positions are samples; all stored in the database that holds the song

nodes.label: Engine DJ metadata: isMetadataImported (0/1), bitrate (kbps), albumArtId
nodes.rationale: Songs added by GLUE differ from Engine DJ's native imports in isMetadataImported (0 vs 1) and bitrate (missing vs present); whether these affect Engine DJ's ability to move songs is [UNVERIFIED]

nodes.label: ADR 0173: Restore of unplugged databases' entries when they reconnect
nodes.rationale: When Engine DJ is reopened, it reconciles playlist trees across available databases; one from an unplugged database is brought into the connected ones if its edit is the newest

nodes.label: ADR 0182: GLUE Home 0.73 - playlist writes into Engine DJ's master database and all copies
nodes.rationale: GLUE's playlist writes now go into Engine DJ's master database (C:) and every other database carrying the tree with the same id, matching how Engine DJ makes playlists; F:'s 5 GLUE-made playlists and the id clash at 9047 put right

hyperedges.label: Engine DJ write-back flow: database schema, metadata, performance data, playlist tree coordination
